conclusion: Both runs passed all ten configured windows and preserved all data. No reliable whole-game CPU or memory improvement is established by this pair. The candidate had a larger rare state gap and peak RSS.
limits: Identical starting world and synthetic calendar, but live scheduling, combat, random grants and production-neighbour load differ. This is not deterministic replay or maximum CCU.
Candidate state gap 464 ms affected multiple clients in the same room and did not span their life ends. Same window includes 221 ms GC and a 364 ms simulation step; exact causality is not proved.
